triageGrades.reason: The change adds a pre-send `ensureFreshAccessToken` session proof and reasons about the dashboard Bearer token, so auth is squarely touched.
No credential storage, env vars, or secret material is added or handled — only an existing in-memory access token is validated.
The whole point of the change is preventing admin-tray messages from being billed against a customer entity's quota and firing owner notifications, and it adds a billing-fact warning banner.
Nothing deletes or overwrites data; the only `clearChat` edit resets two new local refs.

The diff changes when/whether the outbound POST /chat request is issued and how its response fields are consumed, so the API-call path is touched (evidence line points at the history GET rather than the send, but the category call is right).
No build, deploy, version, or config files are changed — only a component plus a new spec file.

summary: The local model found no defects, which matches my own cold read of this change (the guard mirrors the verified LEO-090 playground fix, `isTest` really is returned by backend/src/routes/chat.js, and the new spec's mocks/assertions line up with real behavior), and all six triage answers are right.
